This clause overlaps target paragraphs P0045 and P0046 and uses the full Section 3(a)(1) text to avoid treating the partial anchor as exhaustive.
rules.condition_explanation: shares_licensed_material_including_modified_material means You Share Licensed Material, including in modified form. retain_each_supplied_section_3_a_1_a_item refers to the supplied creator and designated attribution-recipient identification, copyright notice, Public License notice, warranty-disclaimer notice, and URI or hyperlink to the Licensed Material to the extent reasonably practicable; identification must be retained in any reasonable manner requested, including by designated pseudonym. indicate_if_modified_and_retain_indication_of_previous_modifications requires indicating whether the material was modified and retaining an indication of previous modifications. indicate_material_is_licensed_under_public_license_and_include_license_text_or_uri_or_hyperlink requires both identifying the Public License and including its text or a URI or hyperlink to it. Under Section 3(a)(2), the Section 3(a)(1) conditions may be satisfied in any reasonable manner based on medium, means, and context.

obligation_items.content: Retain each item of creator or designated attribution-recipient identification, copyright notice, Public License notice, warranty-disclaimer notice, and Licensed Material URI or hyperlink that the Licensor supplied with the Licensed Material; retain identification in any reasonable manner requested, including a designated pseudonym, and provide the URI or hyperlink to the extent reasonably practicable.
obligation_items.object: The Licensed Material and the listed attribution information supplied with it
obligation_items.trigger: When You Share Licensed Material, including in modified form; retention applies to each listed item only if supplied by the Licensor, and the URI or hyperlink is required to the extent reasonably practicable.

obligation_items.content: Indicate whether the Licensed Material was modified and retain an indication of any previous modifications.
obligation_items.object: The Licensed Material being shared
obligation_items.trigger: When You Share Licensed Material, including in modified form; retaining a previous-modification indication applies when such an indication exists.

obligation_items.content: Indicate that the Licensed Material is licensed under the Public License and include its text or a URI or hyperlink to it.
obligation_items.object: The Licensed Material being shared and the Public License
obligation_items.trigger: When You Share the Licensed Material.

gap_ledger.reason: Section 2(a)(5)(a) provides that each recipient automatically receives an offer from the Licensor to exercise Licensed Rights in Licensed Material. The offer is the Licensor's legal act, not a licensee action that can be faithfully represented by an allowed activity.

Section 2(a)(5)(b) provides that each recipient automatically receives an offer from the Licensor for Licensed Rights in Adapted Material under the conditions of the Adapter's License. This automatic offer by the Licensor is not a licensee action represented by an allowed activity.

Section 2(b)(1) excludes moral, publicity, privacy, and similar personality rights from the licensed rights and states a limited Licensor waiver, qualified by 'to the extent possible' and limited to what is necessary to exercise Licensed Rights. These rights-scope exclusions and waiver are not a licensee behavioral action expressible by an allowed activity.

Section 2(b)(2) states that patent and trademark rights are not licensed. This is a rights-scope boundary, not a grant or licensee action expressible by an allowed activity; no patent or trademark permission is inferred.
The complete Section 3(a)(1) sharing trigger and supplied-information retention conditions are modeled, with the rest of the item list and subsections (B)-(C) supported by cited full-source ranges.

The supplied-information retention duty is modeled with its item-specific supplied-information and reasonable-practicability limits; the clauses also identify the full Section 3(a)(1) conditions without treating the partial immutable anchor as exhaustive.
